language_conclusion: Rust host and JavaScript Web API bindings are legitimate architecture choices. bootstrap.js has a private IIFE capturing the privileged core, and _fpSeed is a closure-local let, not established as a public page global. Correctness depends on real input-responsive semantics and ownership, not implementation language or [native code] labels.

boundaries.finding: Typed input is resolved/persisted in the context constructor before the HTTP client and page creation (not before the CDP server socket binds). Runtime fills its existing private identity slots before __obscura_init/page scripts. Snapshot bootstrap code itself executes at build time, not per-environment; this patch does not replace public page APIs via CDP. Explicit overrides precede seed-selected defaults. Page and same-origin iframe fields and borrowed Worker navigator agree in smoke. Stealth and separate CLI UA conflict fail closed. This is slice schema=1, not full product EnvironmentSpec schema=3.

Baseline op_fetch_url hardcoded UA independently of configured navigation UA. Patch reads configured client UA/Accept-Language for scripted requests and inherited contexts. HTTP/1.1 local server independently observes navigation, redirect, iframe, stylesheet, Worker script, fetch. TLS/H2/Client-Hints and cross-site policy remain unverified. Browser.getVersion metadata remains static and is not wire or page-identity evidence.

boundaries.classification: real V8 contexts with shared host resources
boundaries.finding: Page runtime has its own isolate; child frame contexts restore the snapshot in the same isolate, receive identity and shared host resources, and use origin security tokens. Tested only same-origin iframe; cross-origin and sandbox isolation not established by this smoke.

boundaries.classification: same-realm scoped implementation, not isolated Worker runtime
boundaries.finding: Worker scope borrows navigator/fetch/indexedDB and executes new Function plus with(scope)/eval. Matching identity is not proof of Worker isolation, structured clone, scheduling or transferable semantics. Optimized smoke additionally observed documentType=object and windowType=object inside Worker script: ambient page DOM is reachable, not merely inferred.

boundaries.classification: real native CSS/layout/text rasterizer behind render feature
boundaries.finding: Taffy layouts DOM, cosmic-text FontSystem and SwashCache shape/rasterize text, tiny-skia paints. Actual screenshots and coordinate/text input succeed. Screenshot inspected: Latin text and layout rendered, CJK tofu without additional fonts; image, scroll and live viewer not accepted by this narrow smoke.

boundaries.classification: existing fabricated pseudo-glyph algorithm, not font rendering
boundaries.finding: fillText draws _fpRand 5x7 cells. strokeText delegates fillText; measureText uses character count. Page font renderer is separate. Actual text pixels change across A restarts; not a stable real Canvas result. Patch does not stabilize or extend these fabricated outputs.

connect/start/parameter scheduling are no-ops. Offline rendering generates a fixed 10kHz triangle and rescales toward a hardcoded Chrome fingerprint target. 512-frame smoke produced identical all-zero buffers at 440/880Hz. This is not real graph/DSP behavior. No substitute fake output was introduced. Optimized8192-frame smoke produced exactly identical nonzero buffers for440Hz and880Hz, confirming no oscillator-frequency response.
Empty constructor labels are not backend support. getContext(webgl/webgl2) returns null; required GL shader/pixel/object gates remain outstanding.

boundaries.classification: context stores; added cold-profile IndexedDB snapshot
boundaries.finding: Cookies/localStorage already persist upstream. Added IndexedDB snapshot excludes live handles/transactions, reconstructs quota accounting on restore, writes temp+sync+rename on storage save, and errors on malformed restore. Clean CDP connection closure plus process restart preserves all three stores. It is not write-through transaction durability, crash recovery, multi-process lease, or portable storage migration.

security_limits: No OS sandbox/malicious-page isolation assessment completed. V8 realm security token is not an OS sandbox.
Worker runs in the page isolate/scope and is not a security boundary.
Plaintext identity and profile stores; no secret content used. Local/private network explicitly opted in only for loopback smoke.
Configuration revision changes are rejected against persisted resolved record, but lease/concurrent first-write and crash-atomic config creation are not productized.

Bootstrap private closure is source-backed, not full reflection/detectability or privileged-boundary acceptance. Public Web API object/error semantics and cross-realm behavior require independent runtime checks.
Cold IDB snapshot writes committed state on graceful storage save; errors logged, not a transaction durable-commit receipt.
No anti-bot clearance, anonymity, TLS consistency, proxy leak resistance or production promotion claim.

CDP upstream publishes ready-file before constructing its default context; the initial missing-storage config failure left a ready record before panic. Product READY must move after config/storage validation and emit a typed receipt. Current experimental resolver reports invalid_config via constructor panic, not the final product error protocol.
